textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: If this isn’t the entrance,      then I do not know what is.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: The fog is nearly bubbling out of the valley..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Really looks the part of a Mist Wraiths domain.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Mist wraith?             Is that another one of those mythical creatures?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: It’s not a classic or as simple as a “Ghost”.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: But the creature fits to a place with      {italic}“lost souls”{/italic},         especially if it's overflowing with fog.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I suppose I don't sense much of a threat..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: But if ghosts really are as unbeatable as you said..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: No time to waste!              Ancient secrets await us!

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: At least stay near so we don’t get lost!

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: This is not the time to be sneaking up on people!

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Sorry for the..         Badly timed joke..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: I uhm..          Won’t do it again..             So lets just..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Don’t tell me you are getting scared yourself..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: N-   nono.       I’m fine.             Just gotta…

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Whatever you’d like to call it.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: I shoot something and it expels air pressure.          Great way of clearing any smoke,      smog or..         Fog!

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: At least temporary..        and only stationary.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (She definitely is feeling uneasy..          Though..         I cannot fault her completely.)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (It feels like this fog is weighing on me..)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (As much as I do not sense or hear anything near,    it feels like I’m being..         Watched..        No,       observed.)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (It’s like something is crawling along my skin..)

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: …Say,        jokes aside.          This place does feel..         odd,         right?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (...What  {italic} is {/italic}  this feeling..? It feels almost..)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: You think it was a house?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Looks like it.         Long grown over though.            You think it was abandoned or destroyed?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Hard to tell..          It doesn’t seem all too scattered but also not in place..          Maybe dismantled?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Rrrright..             Who doesn’t pack their brick walls before their departure.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: ..Though it seems cleanly scavenged.            Guess we are too late to the party.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Maybe there is more stuff further in.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Classic line right before someone gets lost..          Or worse.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: …The brick layout makes it look like this was an entire town.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Maybe they had to leave because of the fog?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Well, partly.            It’s definitely not natural fog.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: An actual not broken down building.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: You would think this is prime loot to take apart..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Only one way to find out.           Let’s look for a door.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: I-..           Ok look.              I’m not afraid of ghosts,           I actually don't believe in them…                    but.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: This..          Something is just..           Not right.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Every bone in my body is screaming at me and that is {bold}NOT{/bold} a common occurrence.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Honestly,         I have no idea how {italic}you{/italic} are able to be this calm.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Well I cannot sense anything nearby..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Well,         can you sense a ghost?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I thought you don't believe in ghosts.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Alright...        My bones have not yet overtaken my curiosity..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Just,           promise.            As soon as they do,         we book it.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: We run.     We leave.       We dip out.          Exit stage left.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: This is..           A very normal sized door compared to what I was expecting...

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: …Well I'll be damned..          It {italic}is{/italic} a forgotten library..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (..There is less fog here but it's still present..)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (I can’t look past the 4th floor..           How high does this go?)

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Noticing a clear lack of spider webs..               And dust..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: How-..                How high are the chances of this just being the humble abode of some friendly monster?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: You know.             Like a misunderstood “evil creature” that really just wants to make friends?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: That depends on you calling me a “creature”...

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Calling me a “ghost” is not any better..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Now.               Can we have a normal discussion or will you keep clutching your weapons?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: You are the one who jumped us!

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: And you are the ones entering my quarters without permission.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Now then.              What brings two strangers to such a remote place like this?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Surely you have not just..             stumbled into a clearly fog infested valley and got lost,          right?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Not buying it.            Especially that one.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: He can talk for himself.            Why are you here?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: We..           found this place in a book..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: ...Surely,            it was not one that told you specifically {bold}NOT{/bold} to visit said place,          right?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I told you this was a bad idea.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: And how was I supposed to know it was inhabited anyway?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: So,        you brought him here for the thrills?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Well..         Is that all?             Happy with what you found?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: What did you expect..?             Want me to haunt you or something?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: But sure,          why not.             You may leave under one condition.            He stays.           At least for a bit.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: I’m not leaving him here with you!

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: How delightful...          Then you both may take a seat.              I have some questions that need answering.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: And you better not think about running.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Didn’t you say ghosts are transparent?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Well,       some are but look at her!

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: A ghost child is like {bold}THE{/bold} classic scary trope.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: I bet she is like..         1000 years old.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (I didn’t notice her at all..         Even her breathing is..         slow.)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: You really are committed to this.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Do you actually think she is just some..        Tiny 12 year old in some random tower?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: The “Tiny 12 year old” can hear you..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Besides,             I am deeply offended that you think I am a mere 12 years old..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Now then.         Do you just..           follow her around or..?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I..           I came here to figure out who I am.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I thought that..            Maybe this place had some information.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I’m..          not sure.           But it’s important to me.           At least that's what I feel.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: And how are you feeling now?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: I will be gentle with it..            Just..     kneel down a bit..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: And you know nothing about it?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Not really.           Is there something special about it?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: You could say that much.          As far as I can tell,            this is an actual flower.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: For how long do you remember having this lily?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Since I woke up.      About..     4 days ago?     Probably for longer...

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Huh...       Well it shows no sign of wilting.               Not to mention how long you may have had it before then.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Course.          Everything that lives is destined to wither and fade eventually.         Flowers included.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: It is but a matter of time..       Mostly at least.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Is there anything else you can tell me?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Besides that,     you are        quite..        Odd.             Though I am sure you are well aware of that yourself.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: …Well then.          If you seek a {italic}thrill{/italic} or information about, what I assume, is Fortiris;

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: I would recommend you make your way towards Indarr.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: They currently should be hosting a tournament to determine their ranks for the next half-year.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Lucky for the both of you,          they accept everyone        and          if you reach a certain rank you may get access to their library.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: I presume at least one of you is eager to fight something?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: So eager yet also hesitant to leave..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: We discussed everything,      did we not?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Unless you actually allow me to dissect your flower?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: So unless you would like to spend your night in the 'creatures' quarters,      I would recommend you leave before nightfall.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: We have been traveling all day and have no place to rest.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: ... And this seat is more comfortable than anything I have slept on.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: For you maybe.               I won’t get any shuteye in a place like this.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Is a tree or some leaves any better?

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: At least I'd get some mental rest there..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Well I feel as calm here as I have ever been.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: There..         may be some rooms you could stay in..

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Fine.         Whatever.             What is one night without sleep.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: It is not as bad here as you act...

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Besides,           your legs have stopped shaking a while ago.

textBox.name: Nora
textBox.text: Keep your eyes to yourself,      spectwerp.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (And I still really wanna check out those books..)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (Wonder if Nora isn't able to sleep as well.)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (I wonder how many things are written here that nobody else knows..)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (Probably quite a few..           Some of these look really old.          And others quite the opposite..)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (..?        And from the same year even?)

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Not able to sleep after all?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: How does everyone keep sneaking up on me…

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Kinda.        I’m fond of how they look.           Especially this many.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Not to mention the amount of information stored in them..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Good thing I wrote them then.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: You wrote these?             All of them?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: You must have been here for a while then..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: You better not start trying to guess my age as well…

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Would you..       care to join me for a stroll?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Precisely.           We will not get lost,        if that is your concern.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Uh..       Do I get to look at the books later?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: It is a rare occurrence that anyone comes here, you know...

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: An even rarer one that someone calls it “calming”..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: …Is it normal to {italic}not{/italic} like this place?

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: But the usual response is dread.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (How odd..           This place doesn’t strike me as anything like that.)

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: (It almost makes me feel..           Warm..          It’s nice.)

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: This goes without saying..         But do keep this a secret.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: A field of Lilies..                  Or at least what is left of them..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Withered..           Decayed..           I have yet to find a fitting word..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: No.                    Well..            not quite.             The last one died very recently..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: As far as I am aware,         there is no information about its cause.            Not even about something similar.

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Same goes for any potential cure..              They are barely being held together..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Well..            it is too late for that anyway..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: Carrying an identical lily,        unique to this valley,            as if stuck in time..

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: I..         I’m not sure what to say..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: ..How             do you feel watching this field?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Cold..               but somehow,          also very warm..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: I have seen a lot of odd people in my time..

textBox.name: (Scarlett)
textBox.text: But you..         You take the cake.

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: ..I suppose that is another figure of speech?

textBox.name: Zayn
textBox.text: Scarlett..          I uh-          kinda need your help to find back..
